title: The Mist-Bridge of Thousand Isles
summary: Island ranger clans at Tang Mo Harbor Village and Tang Mo Watch defend the rope-bridge straits and relight the ancestral spire-incense against raiders in the mist.

hook.rumour: Sea-fog thicker than wool has settled over Tang Mo Watch, and someone has cut the warning-gongs along the suspension spans leading to the Thousand Monkey Tree.
hook.notice: TANG MO HARBOR TERRACE: Agile climbers and guards needed to restring the mist-gongs and secure Tang Mo Watch.

npcs.name: Warden of Tang Mo Harbor Village
npcs.greet: Sea-fog thicker than wool has settled over Tang Mo Watch, and someone has cut the warning-gongs along the suspension spans leading to the Thousand Monkey Tree.
talk: The trouble across Tang Mo began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Tang Mo Harbor Village.
If you mean to help the Thousand-Isle Ranger Clans, start by checking the trail between Tang Mo Harbor Village and Thousand Monkey Tree.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Tang Mo Harbor Village
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Thousand Monkey Tree is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Thousand Monkey Tree toward Tang Mo Watch before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Tang Mo Harbor Village so Bridge-Warden Sun-Kao can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Tang Mo Watch
npcs.greet: You made good time from Thousand Monkey Tree. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Tang Mo Watch.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Tang Mo Watch with a picked guard.
Once Tang Mo Watch is cleared, return to Tang Mo Harbor Village to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Tang Mo Harbor Village
npcs.greet: Bridge-Warden Sun-Kao awaits word on whether the crisis in Tang Mo has been contained.
talk: The elders of Tang Mo Harbor Village have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Tang Mo owes you a debt for standing between Tang Mo Harbor Village and ruin.
